🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 29, 2026

Moon, exalted in Taurus, holds an opposition to Venus, in detriment in Scorpio. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Libra, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Fire that starts things, billed for starting. Mars left Cancer four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Earth holds until owning and being coincide. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, moves through Libra unannounced. From Libra, Sun concedes the point early. Mutable air keeps two accounts, and both balance. Mercury has been out of Virgo for four weeks now.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you and is raised above its rank in Taurus. Venus trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water moves first here, and first is enough. The hold Venus had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you, fallen in Libra. Moon in Taurus stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fire keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Sun has not been in Virgo for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Libra with no title of its own. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. Jupiter let go of it a week ago.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is a foreigner in Scorpio and improvises. Sun is with you, close enough to read the small print. Cardinal air opens and closes the same file. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon opposes you from Taurus, and the account has two columns. Water holds on, and the holding is billed. The sextile to Sun that held a week ago has let go.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun in Libra opens a gap you have to step into. Fire adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. A week ago Jupiter was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: an opening to be reached for. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries and defends what needs no defending. From Scorpio, Venus cuts across the appetite. Fixed air pays to hold on. It arrived inside the last seven days.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is a stranger in Leo: neither strong nor weak. Moon in Taurus makes room for you, and then waits. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. Nothing about it is a week old.
